paragraphs: Rosco Vision sells vehicle camera equipment for fleets, grouped on its shop into backup camera kits, sensors and audio kits, and surround camera kits. Rosco D•CAMS is described as a mirrorless camera and monitoring system that replaces exterior rear vision mirrors. The DV6 dash camera kit records the driver and the road and sends alerts inside the cab when risky behaviors are detected.

Video recorded on the device is kept on a 128GB SD card and event video is transmitted to RoscoLive Cloud. The homepage puts the count at more than 1,000 commercial-grade fleets, described as the buyers of the cameras and telematics. Industries listed on the site include public safety, refuse and waste.

The shop page describes the company as a New York company since 1907. The homepage claims US manufacturing for more than 115 years. Products are described as assembled and shipped in the USA and supported under warranty.

quote.text: Protecting more than 1,000 fleets across America
